timeline.summary: Surendrakumar Tibrewala, as Promoter of Fineotex Chemical Limited, declared no encumbrance on promoter-held shares (63.32%) for FY2025-26 under SEBI Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹313.73 Cr (+161.9% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹31.61 Cr (+58.3% YoY).
Fineotex Chemical reported full utilization of ₹91.96 Cr preferential issue proceeds as of March 31, 2026.
Fineotex Chemical reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹313.73 Cr (+162% YoY) and PAT of ₹43.79 Cr (+118% YoY).
Bharatbhai Bharatbhai Parmar shared the Q4 FY2025-26 concall audio recording on May 18, 2026, via the company website.
Fineotex Chemical reported a 162% surge in Q4 revenue and pulled forward its $200M US revenue target to 2028.
Fineotex Chemical announced a 150 million pounds per year manufacturing capacity expansion at its US subsidiary CrudeChem Technology's Texas facility.
